body: Barcelona Data Labs is building the data backbone for the next wave of AI products. We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong Python skills, experience with Spark or dbt, and a good understanding of data modelling. Hybrid position in Barcelona (3 days office, 2 remote). Spanish and English required.

RemoteStack is a 100% distributed team building cloud-native ML platforms. We need an MLOps Engineer to own our model deployment stack: Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, and model serving with FastAPI or Triton. Full remote from Spain. 2+ years experience required.
